# Maternal Mortality, Health Investment & Service Coverage: 8-Country Comparison

## Overview
Four interrelated datasets track maternal mortality outcomes, health spending, skilled birth attendance, and rural-urban disparities across eight low- and middle-income countries (Ethiopia, India, Rwanda, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Cambodia, Peru, Nepal) from 2005 to 2021.

## Data Source

### maternal_mortality_timeseries
- **Fields**: `country` (string, 8 values), `year` (integer, 2005/2009/2013/2017/2021), `mmr` (integer, deaths per 100,000 live births, range 69–946)

- 16 rows (8 countries × 2 settings), representing latest estimates (~2019-2021)

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Parse data
mmr_ts = data['maternal_mortality_timeseries']['data']
hex_ts = data['health_expenditure_gdp']['data']
midwife = data['midwife_coverage']['data']
rural_urban = data['rural_urban_mmr_gap']['data']

countries = ['Ethiopia', 'India', 'Rwanda', 'Bangladesh', 'Nigeria', 'Cambodia', 'Peru', 'Nepal']
years = [2005, 2009, 2013, 2017, 2021]

# Color palette - editorial, muted but distinct
colors = {
    'Ethiopia': '#2D5F8A',
    'India': '#E07B42',
    'Rwanda': '#4CA368',
    'Bangladesh': '#C44E52',
    'Nigeria': '#8C6D8C',
    'Cambodia': '#D4A843',
    'Peru': '#5BA4CF',
    'Nepal': '#7A7A7A',
}

# Compute % decline for annotation
declines = {}
for c in countries:
    vals = [r['mmr'] for r in mmr_ts if r['country'] == c]
    declines[c] = (vals[0] - vals[-1]) / vals[0] * 100

# Sort by decline for top improvers
sorted_by_decline = sorted(countries, key=lambda c: declines[c], reverse=True)
top_improvers = set(sorted_by_decline[:3])  # Ethiopia, Nepal, Cambodia-ish

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#555555',
    'text.color': '#222222',
    'axes.labelcolor': '#333333',
    'xtick.color': '#555555',
    'ytick.color': '#555555',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 22))
fig.suptitle('Maternal Mortality, Health Investment & Service Coverage\nAcross Eight Low- and Middle-Income Countries, 2005–2021',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.975, color='#1a1a1a')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.3, top=0.93, bottom=0.04, left=0.08, right=0.95)

# ─── Panel A: MMR trends + spending (dual axis per country) ───
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_a.set_title('A. Maternal Mortality Trends & Health Expenditure (% GDP)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

for c in countries:
    mmr_vals = [r['mmr'] for r in mmr_ts if r['country'] == c]
    lw = 2.5 if c in top_improvers else 1.4
    alpha = 1.0 if c in top_improvers else 0.6
    ax_a.plot(years, mmr_vals, color=colors[c], linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, marker='o', markersize=4, label=c)
    # label end
    ax_a.annotate(f'{c} ({declines[c]:.0f}% ↓)', xy=(2021, mmr_vals[-1]),
                  xytext=(8, 0), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7.5,
                  color=colors[c], fontweight='bold' if c in top_improvers else 'normal',
                  va='center')

ax_a.set_xlabel('Year')
ax_a.set_ylabel('Maternal Mortality Ratio\n(deaths per 100,000 live births)')
ax_a.set_xlim(2004, 2026)
ax_a.set_xticks(years)
ax_a.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Spending as a secondary axis
ax_a2 = ax_a.twinx()
for c in countries:
    hex_vals = [r['health_exp_pct_gdp'] for r in hex_ts if r['country'] == c]
    ax_a2.plot(years, hex_vals, color=colors[c], linewidth=1, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax_a2.set_ylabel('Health Expenditure (% of GDP)', color='#888888')
ax_a2.tick_params(axis='y', colors='#888888')
ax_a2.spines['right'].set_visible(True)
ax_a2.spines['right'].set_color('#cccccc')
ax_a2.set_ylim(1.5, 9.5)

# Add annotation explaining line styles
ax_a.annotate('Solid lines = MMR   Dashed lines = Health expenditure (% GDP)',
              xy=(0.01, 0.02), xycoords='axes fraction', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', style='italic')
# Bold = top improvers
ax_a.annotate('Bold lines highlight the three steepest-declining countries',
              xy=(0.01, 0.06), xycoords='axes fraction', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', style='italic')

# ─── Panel B: Rural vs Urban gap ───
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_b.set_title('B. Rural–Urban Maternal Mortality Gap', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

rural_vals = {r['country']: r['mmr'] for r in rural_urban if r['setting'] == 'rural'}
urban_vals = {r['country']: r['mmr'] for r in rural_urban if r['setting'] == 'urban'}
sorted_c = sorted(countries, key=lambda c: rural_vals[c] - urban_vals[c], reverse=True)

y_pos = np.arange(len(sorted_c))
bar_h = 0.35
for i, c in enumerate(sorted_c):
    ax_b.barh(i + bar_h/2, rural_vals[c], bar_h, color=colors[c], alpha=0.85, label='Rural' if i == 0 else '')
    ax_b.barh(i - bar_h/2, urban_vals[c], bar_h, color=colors[c], alpha=0.4, label='Urban' if i == 0 else '')
    gap = rural_vals[c] - urban_vals[c]
    ax_b.annotate(f'gap: {gap}', xy=(rural_vals[c] + 10, i), fontsize=7.5, va='center', color='#555555')

ax_b.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_b.set_yticklabels(sorted_c)
ax_b.set_xlabel('MMR (deaths per 100,000 live births)')
ax_b.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
ax_b.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
# Annotation for dark/light
ax_b.annotate('Dark = Rural, Light = Urban', xy=(0.6, 0.95), xycoords='axes fraction', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', style='italic')

# ─── Panel C: Midwife coverage change ───
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_c.set_title('C. Skilled Birth Attendant Coverage\n     (Early vs Recent Period)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

early = {r['country']: r['skilled_birth_attendant_pct'] for r in midwife if r['period'] == '2008-2012'}
recent = {r['country']: r['skilled_birth_attendant_pct'] for r in midwife if r['period'] == '2018-2021'}
sorted_cm = sorted(countries, key=lambda c: recent[c], reverse=True)

y_pos2 = np.arange(len(sorted_cm))
for i, c in enumerate(sorted_cm):
    ax_c.plot([early[c], recent[c]], [i, i], color=colors[c], linewidth=2, zorder=2)
    ax_c.scatter(early[c], i, color=colors[c], s=50, zorder=3, alpha=0.5, edgecolors='none')
    ax_c.scatter(recent[c], i, color=colors[c], s=80, zorder=3, marker='D', edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
    change = recent[c] - early[c]
    ax_c.annotate(f'+{change}pp', xy=(recent[c] + 1.5, i), fontsize=7.5, va='center', color=colors[c], fontweight='bold')

ax_c.set_yticks(y_pos2)
ax_c.set_yticklabels(sorted_cm)
ax_c.set_xlabel('% of Births with Skilled Attendant')
ax_c.set_xlim(0, 108)
ax_c.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax_c.annotate('○ 2008–2012    ◆ 2018–2021', xy=(0.02, 0.02), xycoords='axes fraction', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888')

# ─── Panel D: Scatter — spending vs MMR ───
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax_d.set_title('D. Health Expenditure vs Maternal Mortality\n     (All Countries × All Years)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

    # Draw arrows from first to last
    ax_d.annotate('', xy=(x[-1], y[-1]), xytext=(x[0], y[0]),

ax_e.set_yticklabels(sorted_decline)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Parse data
mmr_ts = data['maternal_mortality_timeseries']['data']
hex_ts = data['health_expenditure_gdp']['data']
midwife = data['midwife_coverage']['data']
rural_urban = data['rural_urban_mmr_gap']['data']

countries = ['Ethiopia', 'India', 'Rwanda', 'Bangladesh', 'Nigeria', 'Cambodia', 'Peru', 'Nepal']
years = [2005, 2009, 2013, 2017, 2021]

# Color palette - editorial, muted but distinct
colors = {
    'Ethiopia': '#2D5F8A',
    'India': '#E07B42',
    'Rwanda': '#4CA368',
    'Bangladesh': '#C44E52',
    'Nigeria': '#8C6D8C',
    'Cambodia': '#D4A843',
    'Peru': '#5BA4CF',
    'Nepal': '#7A7A7A',
}

# Compute % decline for annotation
declines = {}
for c in countries:
    vals = [r['mmr'] for r in mmr_ts if r['country'] == c]
    declines[c] = (vals[0] - vals[-1]) / vals[0] * 100

# Sort by decline for top improvers
sorted_by_decline = sorted(countries, key=lambda c: declines[c], reverse=True)
top_improvers = set(sorted_by_decline[:3])  # Ethiopia, Nepal, Cambodia-ish

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.facecolor': '#FAFAFA',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#555555',
    'text.color': '#222222',
    'axes.labelcolor': '#333333',
    'xtick.color': '#555555',
    'ytick.color': '#555555',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 22))
fig.suptitle('Maternal Mortality, Health Investment & Service Coverage\nAcross Eight Low- and Middle-Income Countries, 2005–2021',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.975, color='#1a1a1a')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, hspace=0.35, wspace=0.3, top=0.93, bottom=0.04, left=0.08, right=0.95)

# ─── Panel A: MMR trends + spending (dual axis per country) ───
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax_a.set_title('A. Maternal Mortality Trends & Health Expenditure (% GDP)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

for c in countries:
    mmr_vals = [r['mmr'] for r in mmr_ts if r['country'] == c]
    lw = 2.5 if c in top_improvers else 1.4
    alpha = 1.0 if c in top_improvers else 0.6
    ax_a.plot(years, mmr_vals, color=colors[c], linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, marker='o', markersize=4, label=c)
    # label end
    ax_a.annotate(f'{c} ({declines[c]:.0f}% ↓)', xy=(2021, mmr_vals[-1]),
                  xytext=(8, 0), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=7.5,
                  color=colors[c], fontweight='bold' if c in top_improvers else 'normal',
                  va='center')

ax_a.set_xlabel('Year')
ax_a.set_ylabel('Maternal Mortality Ratio\n(deaths per 100,000 live births)')
ax_a.set_xlim(2004, 2026)
ax_a.set_xticks(years)
ax_a.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Spending as a secondary axis
ax_a2 = ax_a.twinx()
for c in countries:
    hex_vals = [r['health_exp_pct_gdp'] for r in hex_ts if r['country'] == c]
    ax_a2.plot(years, hex_vals, color=colors[c], linewidth=1, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax_a2.set_ylabel('Health Expenditure (% of GDP)', color='#888888')
ax_a2.tick_params(axis='y', colors='#888888')
ax_a2.spines['right'].set_visible(True)
ax_a2.spines['right'].set_color('#cccccc')
ax_a2.set_ylim(1.5, 9.5)

# Add annotation explaining line styles
ax_a.annotate('Solid lines = MMR   Dashed lines = Health expenditure (% GDP)',
              xy=(0.01, 0.02), xycoords='axes fraction', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', style='italic')
# Bold = top improvers
ax_a.annotate('Bold lines highlight the three steepest-declining countries',
              xy=(0.01, 0.06), xycoords='axes fraction', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', style='italic')

# ─── Panel B: Rural vs Urban gap ───
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_b.set_title('B. Rural–Urban Maternal Mortality Gap', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=12)

rural_vals = {r['country']: r['mmr'] for r in rural_urban if r['setting'] == 'rural'}
urban_vals = {r['country']: r['mmr'] for r in rural_urban if r['setting'] == 'urban'}
sorted_c = sorted(countries, key=lambda c: rural_vals[c] - urban_vals[c], reverse=True)

y_pos = np.arange(len(sorted_c))
bar_h = 0.35
